name: rag-demo
description: Demo for the project Earground. RAG-powered AIS/AES analysis tool.

paragraphs: This project involves developing a web application that enables users to explore and analyze Customs Import Procedures and Customs Export Procedures through AI-powered natural language interactions. The system architecture consists of a Python backend built with FastAPI, which serves as the bridge between the frontend interface and a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system. The RAG system leverages advanced techniques such as vector embeddings, semantic search, and prompt engineering to retrieve relevant information from the reports and generate insightful, contextual responses.
